description.value: The Great Indian Cuisine is an authentic Indian restaurant on Fraser Highway in Surrey with a broad menu spanning tandoori specialties, vegetarian dishes, chicken, meat, and seafood — each customizable to mild, medium, or hot spice levels. The restaurant serves both dine-in and takeout, and extends its offerings to event catering throughout Surrey. Its dedicated vegetarian section and Lassi-and-dessert drinks menu make it a substantive meal stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley corridor.
